description: This PHP class defines a delivery log component for handling VAST impression data, including methods for retrieving bucket table details, statistics table name, and migration mapping.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogVast_LogImpressionVast
classes.description: A PHP class for managing VAST impression logging and statistics in a delivery log system.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the log component.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing impression data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns the columns and their types for the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for VAST data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping for migrating bucket data into statistics.
